case_number: 2023 INSC 1592; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 1592 OF 2023 (@ SLP (CRL.) NO. 6688 OF 2017)

parties.respondent: The State of West Bengal & Anr.

summary: Delay in filing complaint; alleged theft of bus in 2001, FIR registered in 2009; quashing of proceedings sought; allegations of forgery, breach of trust, criminal conspiracy under IPC; inordinate delay undermines credibility; abuse of process argued; non-compoundable offences; documents on transfer produced late; High Court dismissal of revision upheld or set aside based on prima facie case and procedural fairness.
legal_provisions_cited: State of Haryana v. Bhajan Lal
G. Sagar Suri v. State of U.P.
Madhavrao Jiwajirao Scindia v. Sambhajirao Angre
Subal Ghorai v. State of West Bengal
State of Gujarat v. Gajanand M. Dalwadi
Jagdish Ram v. State of Rajasthan
Kaptan Singh v. State of Uttar Pradesh
final_judgment: Appeals disposed of; criminal proceedings quashed or upheld depending on abuse of process and delay; final disposition determined after evaluating credibility and procedural timeliness.
